course.title: Transportation Planning

content.value: Write down the differences between direction and destination oriented bus routes. What are the basic principles of fixing up the length of a bus route? Why is it important to avoid the overlapping of Bus Route Pairs? How will you avoid the overlapping of bus route pairs during the planning process of bus routes?
